answers.reply:
I added no interaction edge into the Data Loading node. An interaction edge carries selections between views: it links two views when one of them highlights what it receives, a view and a Data Pool, two Data Pools, or a Map Editor and the Autark map it feeds. A Data Loading node shows no selection, so an interaction edge cannot go into it, and the plan check refuses one.

Instead, link the bar chart to the Data Pool with an interaction edge: the pool marks the roofs of the clicked zip code, the rows whose "interacted" column is "1", and a node after the pool can keep only those rows for the nodes it feeds.
